title: A reminder Resend accepts and then drops for the daily limit is sent again the next day

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18 (thread: Check every email and message system)

detail:
2026-11-18: Resend accepts a send over the account's daily limit and then reports email.failed with reason reached_daily_quota. The outbox already marked it accepted, so it is lost: 25 such failures from Nov 12 to Nov 18, mostly event reminders. the reserve valve in EMAIL-060 (PR #5225) makes this rarer once switched on, and a Transactional plan without a daily cap removes it, but when it happens a transactional email should go back on the outbox for the next UTC day: the webhook can look up email_provider_attempts by provider_id and re-enqueue its frozen payload once (bulk sends stay dropped; a campaign already counts them as failed). Done when the webhook handles reached_daily_quota and the probe passes.

The Resend webhook requeues a transactional email that email.failed reports as reached_daily_quota: it finds the send in email_provider_attempts by provider_id and puts the frozen payload back on the outbox for the next UTC midnight, once (lib/comms/quota-requeue.ts). Bulk stays dropped; the enqueue is keyed on the original queue job, so a redelivered webhook queues nothing twice. Covered by lib/comms/quota-requeue.test.ts and the webhook route test.

verify.note: Passes once the Resend webhook requeues a transactional send that email.failed reports as reached_daily_quota.
